name: agentready
description: Oasis: turn a local business website into tools AI assistants can use.

scripts.setup: node scripts/init-env.mjs && npm --prefix auth install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv --directory backend sync && uv --directory backend run playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n auth,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix auth run dev" "uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --timeout-graceful-shutdown 3 --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:public: concurrently -k -n auth,api,web,tunnel -c magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npm --prefix auth run dev" "uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --timeout-graceful-shutdown 3 --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "node scripts/tunnel.mjs"
